result.summary: This residential intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian safety infrastructure, including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and visible traffic control devices. The wide, open roadway design encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases the exposure time for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this intersection, leaving pedestrians with no designated or protected space to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate vehicle right-of-way at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The transition from the sidewalk to the street lacks ADA-compliant ramps, creating a barrier for those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk near the white house

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install directional curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points.

interventions.title: All-Way Stop Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs to regulate traffic flow and provide predictable gaps for pedestrians to cross.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection that lacks fundamental pedestrian safety infrastructure, including marked crosswalks, stop signs, and curb ramps. While the area features mature street trees, the wide unmarked asphalt and discontinuous sidewalk network create a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are visible to regulate vehicle right-of-way at this four-way junction.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground intersection

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks increases exposure and fails to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all legs of the intersection

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalk Network
hazards.description: Sidewalks are missing on several corners, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved surfaces.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all four legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: All-Way Stop Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs and stop bars to manage vehicle speeds and clarify right-of-way at the intersection.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile due to a complete lack of sidewalks and marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to walk in the roadway or on unpaved grass shoulders, directly adjacent to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: The absence of sidewalks forces pedestrians to walk in the travel lane or on uneven grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the frame

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or protected areas for pedestrians to cross the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right side of the road may obscure pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road where cars are parked

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation from vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with appropriate signage and curb ramps to provide safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the travel lanes to encourage lower vehicle speeds and reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a sidewalk on one side but lacking marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures. Road markings, including sharrows and a large 'X', appear faded and the pavement surface is in poor condition.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely despite the residential context.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear on the road surface can create trip hazards or affect vehicle control.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way at intersections or mid-block points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and degraded roadway to improve safety for all road users.
